name: OnePlus 15
notes: PLK110 = China (ColorOS), CPH2747 = Global (OxygenOS; certification listing). Other regional model numbers not confirmed yet. Recovery board name not known yet. Check-only until tested on a real phone (Qualcomm ARB not validated). From ColorOS 16.0.3.501 the bootloader has a hardware anti-rollback fuse: installing an older build bricks the phone beyond EDL repair (reported Jan 2026 for OnePlus 13, 13T, 15). Applied to every variant until OxygenOS is confirmed either way.
